job_description.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job_description.jd_text: We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer with 8 to 12 years of experience in cloud infrastructure and CI/CD automation. The candidate must have deep AWS DevOps expertise for pipeline orchestration and cloud operations, Kubernetes for container orchestration and cluster management, Terraform for infrastructure-as-code provisioning across multi-cloud environments, Docker for containerisation and image management, and Jenkins for CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance. job_description.title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
job_description.jd_text: We are looking for a Senior Azure DevOps Engineer with 6 to 10 years of experience. The candidate must have Azure DevOps for end-to-end project management and pipeline orchestration, Azure Pipelines for CI/CD pipeline design including YAML-based pipeline authoring, Kubernetes for container orchestration (preferably AKS), Terraform for Azure infrastructure-as-code, and Docker for container image management. Location: Pune, Hybrid work model.
